title: When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2610.01243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly act as judges that pick the best of several generated images, so their choices decide what users see. Such judges are usually validated by score agreement with human ratings, not by the images they return. We audit VLM judges as decision-makers: on 300 culturally situated prompts, we compare the returned image with human ratings the judge never sees and with random choice from the same candidates, and repeat every decision with the candidates reordered. A 4B-parameter judge barely beats random and falls short of a CLIP similarity baseline. It picks the first image shown in 49% of calls (chance: 28%), and reordering changes its choice on 60% of prompts. For this judge, agreement across orders is informative: decisions that survive reordering are much better than random, whereas agreement with a weaker second judge keeps the wrong ones. An 8B judge shows almost no position bias and outperforms C

translated_title: 当裁判行动时：对文化情境提示下VLM引导的图像选择进行审计
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型越来越多地充当“裁判”，从多张生成的图像中挑选最佳者，因此它们的选择决定了用户所看到的内容。这类裁判通常通过与人类评分的分数一致性来验证，而不是通过它们实际返回的图像来验证。我们将VLM裁判作为决策者进行审计：在300个文化情境化的提示上，我们将裁判返回的图像与其从未见过的人类评分进行比较，并与从相同候选图像中随机选择的结果进行比较，同时将候选图像重新排序后重复每次决策。一个4B参数的裁判几乎无法超越随机选择，且低于CLIP相似度基线。它在49%的调用中选择了第一张展示的图像（随机概率为28%），重新排序会在60%的提示上改变其选择。对于该裁判而言，跨顺序的一致性是有信息量的：在重新排序后依然保持的决策远好于随机，而与较弱的第二裁判的一致性则会保留错误的选择。一个8B参数的裁判几乎没有表现出位置偏差，并且性能优于C（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次将VLM裁判作为决策者而非评分者进行审计，发现4B小模型裁判存在严重位置偏差（49%的情况下选择第一张图）且接近随机水平，并提出“重新排序后决策一致性”可作为识别可靠图像选择的有效信号。
en_tdlr: This paper audits VLM judges as decision-makers rather than scorers on culturally situated prompts, revealing that a 4B judge barely beats random with strong position bias (picking the first image 49% of the time), and that consistency of decisions under candidate reordering serves as an informative signal for reliable image selection.
